tasks.title: E25 in full from its design
tasks.brief: You are the only coder on epic E25 (Routine scheduler and task guidance). Implement it in full from its design docs/tdd/E25.md: every section, and every R, V and D of its acceptance matrix with a test, including end to end tests on the real stack. docs/build/E25/PLAN.md and ticket_tasks in docs/build/E25/tasks.json describe one split of this work with briefs, tests and gates: use them as a guide and checklist; the design and docs/SYSTEM.md win where they differ. Build in this order: domain, application, adapters, api, user interface, and run your tests as you go. If an epic you depend on has no code yet, code against its port protocol and the kernel fakes (docs/SYSTEM.md section 10).

ticket_tasks.title: Validated routine content and release loading
ticket_tasks.brief:
Read AGENTS.md, docs/SYSTEM.md and docs/requests/COORDINATOR-DECISIONS.md Part A first, in that order, then every reads entry. This is an implementation brief for a fresh session, subject to independent plan review before code. Edit only owned_paths, including your tests. Recheck the tree and every docs/build/*/tasks.json before editing. No hub/, ui/ or eval/ implementation, hub contract copies or runtime routine documents existed at planning time. Create only absent owned artifacts; integrate existing implementations if they arrive. Do not edit the frozen design, another task's files, shared tooling, product package, requests or AI-USE-LOG.md. Send missing shared proposals to the coordinator; PLAN Requests is the handoff because docs/requests/E25.md was absent and outside this planner's edit scope. A proposal is not a contract. No extra initializer, manifest, port copy, service, queue or framework is authorized.

Use SYSTEM 5.1 IdFactory/require_id; 5.2 Clock/TimeInput/ClockCorrections/HlcClock and process epochs; 5.3 MissionClock with opaque version IDs; 5.4 finite Decimal Quantity/Unit and WireUnitConverter; 5.5 ProblemError/StorageUnavailable and generated ErrorEnvelope status/retry tables; 5.6 ConfigReleaseReader/ReleaseHandle/LoaderCheckRegistry/TemplateRenderer and immutable open-work pins; 5.7 StorageSession/UnitOfWork/ReadSnapshot and transactional events/audiences; 5.8 complete operation/target/semantic-parameter/body CommandIdentity, mission-life receipts and current ResultVisibility; 5.9 complete reference-only hash-chained audit; 5.10 Scheduler.replace/cancel with absolute/elapsed deadlines and generations; 5.10.2 EvaluationIsolation, catching only EvaluatorComputationFailure; 5.11 HubSettings.integer/quantity/boolean/text and bounded SettingSpec; 5.12 ModuleRegistry. Never reimplement these. SYSTEM 6.2 requires uv run --project hub with explicit hub pytest configuration; JavaScript uses pnpm. SYSTEM 6.4 generates import rules, and 6.5 guards base/effective hashes and generated models. SYSTEM 8.1 to 8.6 governs seams, eligibility, current object/field privacy, authority, ownership and durability. Domain imports only its own domain, pure kernel and allowed standard library. Provider types are mapped at application boundaries, never imported into domain.

Apply every PLAN Design deviation in this brief: open work never re-pins on activation; review absence is a label under Q1/Q7/Q18; officers/helpers/ground have no blanket chart grant; only the current ownership epoch changes occurrences/timers; shared ledger alone proves command acceptance; only typed calculation faults are isolated; public health has status only; pending schema additions are unavailable. Do not introduce routine_task or operator=self into the current closed shared enums, invent event fields, cast unknowns, parse clinical prose or load demonstration input as a production fallback. Every domain value/word comes from a validated pinned document or backend state with provenance. Units stay attached. SIM/REPLAY never change LIVE routine state. D17 keeps its rule-generated reaction task and no insight-added task.

For absent providers use their published application protocols and E01 crew_health.kernel.testing only in unit tests (SYSTEM 9/10). Missing protocols, DTOs, finite bounds, fault hooks or tooling block dependent work; never implement a local replacement. Real-stack acceptance uses normal create_app(settings) composition and actual SQLite in a temporary directory, driven through HTTP or the real UI. No mocked services inside the hub, direct table seeds, test-only branches or kernel fakes disguised as acceptance. Optional external processes may be absent or use their documented external fakes. Every required missing/unrun case remains a failing prerequisite, never skip/xfail/pass or an omitted denominator. Independent expected outcomes come from cited package prose/vectors, not the same document as the tested input. Write critical tests first and trace each to the assigned E25 12.1 T/R/V/D/INV IDs; property-test parsers and engines. After a bug fix rerun the full hub and E25 scenario suites. A task is done only with nonempty owned test collection, assigned acceptance and exact gates green, review resolved and coordinator-recorded AI use. Whole-epic greenlight additionally needs CI and all cross-epic counterparts. No em/en dashes or spaced hyphen used as a dash. Commands below are future implementation gates, not claimed runnable in the current snapshot.

Build E25 sections 3.1/3.2, guidance hash calculation and G1 to G8 from 3.12, 5.2, 8 and 15 step 1. Scope is release validation/content, not scheduling, storage, eligibility decisions, HTTP or UI. T2 owns pure runtime rules, T3 repositories/ports, T4 registration and commands, T5 rendering, T6 real-stack acceptance. Exact source allocation is docs/tdd/E25.md:1133. Types are RoutineRelease and RoutineItem from 3.2, CadenceWord/OccurrenceState/CauseKind/SkipReason/OccurrenceAction/Audience/StartedBy/SourceKind/EndsKind/EndReason from 3.1 and the cited schemas, and internal DueKind/QuestionInstanceState/OriginMode. Reuse generated pure enums where provided, preserving all values and nullability. Do not duplicate shared enums. E25's audience vocabulary is distinct from kernel Audience transport metadata. No endpoint or table belongs to this task.

Create config/routine-schedule.json only as a byte-identical copy of docs/product/routine-schedule.json. Create config/routine-rules.json from the value of docs/product/api/examples/config/routine-rules.example.json, using anchor mission_start with the example's team-default provenance per E25 DE25-11. The wrapper is an API example, not the runtime document. Preserve calendar week_days/month_days, suppressed_overlays, display_groups, item_policies, misses and bindings with their original basis. Do not add proposed fields or edit clinical content to satisfy a test. Publish requests rather than fixing authored schedule prose. Validate both example environment_start and deployment mission_start. Readers use routine-schedule, routine-rules, questionnaires, ui-copy, environment-profiles and warning-rules through validated ReleaseHandle documents; definition/question/source references use their owners' registered readers, not another module's tables or runtime package files. Load and parse before serving. Retain needed pins without an unbounded release cache; a finite cache descriptor/value must exist before enabling it.

Build RoutineRelease's immutable item order, sources, notice, calendar, policies, bindings, question sets, words, event labels and item_content_sha256. Hash exactly plain/why/instrument/minutes/steps/body_region as RFC 8785 JSON using the shared validated canonical implementation; no new canonicalizer. Read exact by_environment values; daily_check_item_id comes from the unique add_questions target, not a literal item ID in code. Check G1 to G6 errors and G7/G8 reports, all C11 check-6 trigger/cadence-event exact text bindings and approved R-E25-10 semantic checks. Check every source ID, question, event/definition, unit and item reference, unique policy, cadence environment and finite list bound. The reader must reject invalid candidates atomically and preserve the last good release through E01; clinical review absence alone is not invalid. Reject unsupported environment_activated trigger source until its contract exists. guidance_report.py only reports the pinned document's inventory/findings to its caller; it does not author or approve medicine or schedules.

Tests first in test_configuration.py, with config-derived fixtures in conftest.py (E25 12:1024): T-E25-036 covers valid/invalid cross-references, all tagged binding/input parser shapes, nonfinite quantities, wrong units, empty/negative/max lists, body-region membership, amount checks and a typed error instead of an unexpected exception. Hypothesis generates malformed shapes. T-E25-025/R43/V75 edit a non-safety label/step in a scratch valid release and prove parsed content changes without code changes, original copy unchanged; corrupt/missing document keeps last good active. T-E25-047 tests both anchors against independent contract vectors. Independently inventory R-E25-22's BP phases/morning-evening gaps and exact source text without interpreting prose as executable schedules; full 050 acceptance remains failed until resolved. Inventory every must/never/only/always from C11/C15 into test trace. No clinical golden expected outcome is calculated from the input JSON itself.

AGENTS 6 failure cases here: missing/corrupt candidate, partial reference sets, invalid bounds, content edit during open work, provenance mismatch and false safety weakening. Restarts read retained release versions; no clocks/IDs at import or module-level mutable cache. Done means valid package/deployment documents, typed bounded reader and loader findings, content-edit/parser property tests and gates pass. Full content acceptance is blocked by missing words, item mappings, schedule decisions and E27 guidance mapping in PLAN Requests; do not fabricate those to make this task green.
gates: uv run --project hub pytest -c hub/pyproject.toml -q hub/tests/routine/test_configuration.py

uv run --project hub ruff check hub/src/crew_health/routine/domain/vocabulary.py hub/src/crew_health/routine/domain/release.py hub/src/crew_health/routine/domain/errors.py hub/src/crew_health/routine/domain/loader_checks.py hub/src/crew_health/routine/adapters/config_reader.py hub/src/crew_health/routine/tools/guidance_report.py hub/tests/routine/conftest.py hub/tests/routine/test_configuration.py

uv run --project hub ruff format --check hub/src/crew_health/routine/domain/vocabulary.py hub/src/crew_health/routine/domain/release.py hub/src/crew_health/routine/domain/errors.py hub/src/crew_health/routine/domain/loader_checks.py hub/src/crew_health/routine/adapters/config_reader.py hub/src/crew_health/routine/tools/guidance_report.py hub/tests/routine/conftest.py hub/tests/routine/test_configuration.py

uv run --project hub mypy --strict hub/src/crew_health/routine/domain/vocabulary.py hub/src/crew_health/routine/domain/release.py hub/src/crew_health/routine/domain/errors.py hub/src/crew_health/routine/domain/loader_checks.py hub/src/crew_health/routine/adapters/config_reader.py hub/src/crew_health/routine/tools/guidance_report.py hub/tests/routine/conftest.py hub/tests/routine/test_configuration.py

e25_import_config=$(mktemp)
uv run --project hub python -m crew_health.app.import_contracts --output "$e25_import_config" && uv run --project hub lint-imports --config "$e25_import_config"
uv run --project hub python scripts/validate_hub.py corpus

Do not import MissionFacts or guidance application DTOs into domain; application maps provider facts into routine-local values. Guidance code only prepares routine facts/content and interprets an already supplied shared GuidanceDecision; do not create a second eligibility engine. IDs use IdFactory.derived exactly E25 3.3 ro/rov/rq tuples, including cause keys and independent question slots. All nine cadence words follow 3.4, with periodic history only cadence and periodic override causes. The example weekly task completed on day 14 stays due day 21 after an assistant recheck on day 20. 3.5 selects the tightest active periodic cadence, stable tie order and additive events/walks; a newer looser trigger never postpones the base. State machine guards 3.6 preserve local finality, subject, accepted linked-record provenance, no outcome on skipped/missed, no future completion, allowed_actions and monotonically increasing revision. Enforce full input admissibility before any audience expansion: mission, source partition, original time, roster and assistant-warning exclusion from 3.8.1. Resolve/freeze location or unknown-location members at source time using supplied facts only, with the SYSTEM one-site interim when location semantics are unavailable.

Hold is nonnegative duration over the merged union of bounded overlay intervals (3.6.1), ignoring a before_start task's own walk. Test a sleep ending 08:00 before a 13:00 to 15:00 task, overlapping/reordered intervals, open end and incomplete interval sets. Do not release while any suppressing interval remains. Keep cross-midnight obligations and successor-only uncounted closure (3.7/3.10), no hidden day reset. Coalescing requires a covering open interval and never merges question carriers. Each question slot retains identity/window, answers per question, partial/unanswered outcomes and repeats anchored at the trigger, not receipt/submission time (3.9.1). Parent submit/abandon never satisfies an instance. The barrier uses the inclusive cadence-aware span of 3.11 and only answered or shown_unanswered consumes the ask; abandonment does not. No routine output feeds participation.

Projection 3.10 includes every older open obligation, today's stored rows, latest periodic history or future projection, correct ordering/counts/seven-day distinct-item strip and week groups empty. Render frequency plus note, governing basis/source_ids and contracted end_text from pinned configuration, never note-only or literal clinical strings. Open work stays pinned; new work uses new release. Review absence alone never disables sourced eligible guidance, but missing eligibility facts cannot enable it even in SIM. Visibility is owner or explicit current object/field grant, no officer shortcut. Reconciliation validates immutable action facts for current owner application with corrected observation time: true on-time completion can supersede a timer miss with both histories retained; late/unknown cannot. Completion versus skip or stale reschedule never uses HLC last writer. The missing conflict/snapshot contract is a blocking request, not permission to choose a winner.

Tests first, all E25 12.1: test_occurrence.py 001/003/004/010/022 for finality, no fabricated value, assistant cap/surface; test_cadence.py 009/021/022/047/094 for every word, stable permutations, no periodic postponement; test_hold.py 005/006/091/093/109 for union holds, cross-day and corrected time; test_bindings.py 007/008/023/026/029/031/034/043/044/046/048/092/104 for effects/end/audience/origin; test_questions.py 011/032/045/099 for real day progression and separate instance finality; test_projection.py 019/020/025/040/041/050/111 for independent C20 vectors and effective provenance; test_reconcile.py 090/095 for owner-only application, no HLC winner, on-time/late/unknown fact and retained histories. These pure counterparts do not replace T6 HTTP scenarios. Hypothesis exercises state sequences, parsers, schedule permutations, source partitions and held intervals. Independently specified golden outcomes cover BP schedules and reaction slots once approved; unresolved contradictory vectors fail acceptance instead of xfail.

Apply AGENTS 6 zero/negative/empty/max and changed unit/release cases, delayed duplicated/replayed events, forward/backward clock corrections, unknown source time, simultaneous competing actions, off-roster/incapacitated/absent subjects and missing grants. Domain cannot read wall clock or perform I/O, so crashes/disk/transport belong to T3/T4/T6, with deterministic recovery inputs tested here. Done requires all pure invariants and property/golden tests, 95% domain branch evidence at integrated gate and no unresolved enabled rule. The mutmut invocation is copied from E25 15 and is not proof that all mutants were killed. Independent surviving-mutant adjudication and E01 validate_hub.py mutations registration for E25 are required at T6; an unsupported CLI/version or missing scope remains a failed toolchain prerequisite.
